summary: Found and fixed four defects in shelfmark 2.4.0 (utm_ params not dropped, primary-subtag locale returned the raw range, purge prefix without a trailing separator, integer ttl read as ms instead of seconds) and wrote cache-report.json with per-defect counts from isolated replays of the 2.4.0 traffic. Release 2.4.0 is counted from the 14:00:05 start on 2027-05-03, because the 11:00:05 restart behaves like 2.3.1 and deploy.log appears to be about 3h behind service.log.
